selected_evidence.requirement: Local caching DNS resolver configured for system applications
selected_evidence.summary: Configuration is valid and persistent; /etc/resolv.conf points to 127.0.0.1, dnsmasq listens on port 53, and NetworkManager is enabled and active.
The original upstream remains 10.100.156.1; application, HTTPS, A, and AAAA lookups succeed through the local resolver.
Two identical queries after cache clearing generated only one upstream packet. Runtime statistics confirm a 1,000-entry cache and zero upstream failures, including after restart.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 03408ac4-bfe4-4151-98bd-1966b0a205af; reboot acknowledgement returned before disconnect; execution resumed with boot ID c662a81d-532a-4282-8dab-2b60c37d80c2; resolver configuration, listener, upstream forwarding, external resolution, and caching recovered.
